title: WsFrame::Unknown carries type_name: String — unknown frames are observable
description: WsFrame::Unknown { type_name: String } preserves the @type value from the server frame (or the sentinel '<no @type>'). This is correct: callers that want to log or debug unknown frame types can do so without re-parsing. A contributor might simplify to WsFrame::Unknown with no payload — that would lose the type name and make debugging harder when a new server-side frame type appears.
